name: San Leandro Police Explorers (Post 540)
what_you_do: Learn the basics of police work from officers at weekly meetings. Help at city events like the Cherry Festival, act as role players in SWAT and hostage training, and go to a summer Explorer Academy in San Diego.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 19 when you apply. You must be in high school with a C (2.0) GPA or higher and no grade below C-. You must show good responsibility and maturity.
duration: Ongoing. Weekly meetings plus events and a summer academy.
deadline_text: The page does not list application dates. Apply any time.
how_to_apply: Download the application from the city page, fill it out, and email it to SLPDexplorers@sanleandro.org. The application asks for a report card copy and a typed one-page essay. Then you take a background check, a 9-code test (80% to pass) and an interview.
notes: The web page says ages 14 to 19 and high school students. The older application form says ages 14 to 20.5 and high school or college students. A parent must sign for applicants under 18. Questions: Sergeant Watson, cwatson@sanleandro.org.
